items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: The interviewee discusses Babe Russon and Jacky Russon, but when the interviewer introduces Ham Russon, the interviewee does not claim to know him personally, only asking for clarification on who he was ('The trumpet player?').

ctx.x: Well, yeah, he used to come up to White Plains. And sometimes he'd come up. Did you record? And some other boys came up to, I can't remember, oh, the tenor man, Babe Russon used to come up. Oh, yeah? Yeah, Babe Russon used to come up.
And there was Ham Russon too.
Babe, and then his brother played piano, Jacky Russon played piano.
